caption: The drawing shows a pitcher positioned in the center of an off-white rectangular sheet, with a thin black border framing the entire image. The pitcher is outlined in black ink and features ornate detailing. It has a rounded body, a curved handle on the left, and a spout on the right. The pitcher stands on three decorative feet, each with a fluted pattern ending in a shell or fan-like design. On the body of the pitcher, near the center, there is a stylized letter “B” and an ornamental motif below it. The background is plain and unadorned. There are no colors other than the black outline on the off-white background.
title: Silver Creamer
